statusRule: Author canon is accepted; scientific and scholarly support remains verification-required until reviewed.

claims.title: Energy and Intelligence as divine synthesis
claims.summary: All existence was caused by the synthesis of Energy and Intelligence called Energence.

claims.title: Three modes of Energence
claims.summary: The Father names the nonconscious ground, Holy Spirit-Mother the subconscious formative activity, and Resurrected Christic Consciousness awakened participation.

claims.title: Evolution as divine immanence
claims.summary: Evolution is interpreted as the immanent mechanism through which Energence diversifies life and brings forth conscious beings.

claims.title: Everything in God; God beyond everything
claims.summary: Every physical state participates in Energence informationally, while Energence exceeds every presently manifested form.

claims.title: A tendency toward comprehensive coherence
claims.summary: Existence is theologically interpreted as tending toward increasingly comprehensive coherence, relationship, consciousness, and communion.

claims.title: Evidence and interpretation must remain distinct
claims.summary: The manuscript must distinguish established evidence, scientific hypothesis, philosophical inference, scriptural exegesis, and constructive theology.
